RJGG.notes: USD prices converted to JPY (ECB rate, 13 Oct 2026). AIR CONTRAIL: Night Surcharge: JPY 112,500 (GLEX). UNIVERSAL (Evans Aviation Ground Services Japan) invoices 00023521 (A6-FLH GLF4, 18-19 Sep 2026), 00023597 (A6-FLH GLF4, 1-3 Oct 2026) and 00023714 (A6-AFA GLEX, 18-25 Oct 2026): handling 545,000, after hours 25% of handling once per flight (23:00-07:00 local, safe side), coordination 105,000 in Supervision Fee, permit 180,000, landing as tariff, parking per started 24 h (GLF4 6,800, GLEX 9,200; same for Air Contrail and Mainami), terminal services 550,000, international tourist tax 21,000 / 18,000 (3,000 per departing pax), security surcharge 3,850, admin 10% on airport and third-party items (15% on the September invoice). Navigation varies by route (63,000-131,000). Ramp transportation 44,000 and visitor identification card 10,000 per card as tick rows. USER DECISIONS 26 Nov 2026, from the Mainami quotation (16 Sep 2026, private, GL7T/GLEX/GLF4), the Aeroworks RJGG fee schedule and the Air Contrail quotations QT-33/34/35 (16 Sep 2026, private): Tax / Duty row is the International Tourist Tax, 3,000 per departing pax, at every handler. Terminal services (business jet terminal) 550,000 at every handler. Mainami overtime 30% for arrivals 20:00-05:30 and departures 22:00-07:30, entered as one window 20:00-07:30; charter application 55,800; ramp bus 16,800 x 4; navigation (approx 230,000) and ramp bus without the 10% admin, as quoted; transaction charge 3%. Aeroworks: permit 20,000 + slot 20,000; ramp bus 10,000 x 4; commission 3% (7% by credit card); landing, parking, terminal from the common charges; morning and night fee 25% 22:00-06:00; meet service 15,000 (25,000 20:00-08:00). Air Contrail (FLIGHT SUPPORT): handling incl. towing, one pushback, lav, water and trash; overtime outside 09:00-21:00 flat 112,500; charter permit 50,000; ramp shuttle 18,000 x 4; security inspection for crew 150,000 (no admin), in the Anti-Hijack row; GPU 52,000 per hour; admin 15% on third-party items; crew transport 88,000 per car one way; navigation 230,000 (safe side). Not entered: PSFC (commercial terminal only), VIP lounge 27,500 per hour, catering cost, cancellation charges, rescheduling charges, request within 24 h +25%. USER DECISIONS 26 Nov 2026 (Interaviation quotations 16 Sep 2026 for GLF4 / GLEX / GL7T, USD at 150 JPY in the quote, panel keeps the ECB rate): navigation, terminal services and security are the same at every handler: navigation GL7T 256,000 and all other groups 230,000 (highest of the documents; Interaviation 996.79 / 1,164.36 / 1,205.05 USD, Universal invoices 63,000-131,000, Mainami approx 230,000), terminal services 550,000 (business jet terminal 220,000 for pax + 55,000 for crew, each way), security surcharge 3,850. Anti-hijack security charge 150,000 per departure as a tick row at every handler (Air Contrail 150,000, Interaviation main terminal 500 USD). Interaviation: landing and parking from the common charges, night 25% 22:00-08:00, ramp bus 180 USD x 4, permit 300 + slot 50 USD, extra manpower 88 USD per man-hour. Air Contrail CIQ arrangement 30,000 + NACCS 6,000 x 2 in one basket row. Not entered: main terminal facility charge, PSFC, de-icing, crew shore pass, technician, delay and cancellation charges, VAT. Flight plan filing as a tick row (Interaviation USD 60; Mainami includes it in basic handling).
